title: Protocol for detecting macrophage-mediated cancer cell phagocytosis in vitro and in vivo
protocol: Count and harvest 2 × 10^6 shControl and shCD47 H1975 cancer cells into two 15 mL centrifuge tubes, respectively.
Wash the cells with 5 mL PBS buffer.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL complete DMEM medium.
Add 1 μL CFSE to the cell suspension to achieve a final concentration of 5 μM.
Incubate the cell suspension at 37°C for 10 minutes in darkness, inverting several times to mix thoroughly.
Add 10 mL of complete DMEM medium and invert to mix.
Centrifuge the mixture at 400 × g for 5 minutes at 20°C–25°C.
Wash the cells twice with 5 mL complete DMEM medium.
Resuspend the cancer cell pellet in 1 mL complete DMEM medium.
Culture macrophages (BMDM or THP1 induced macrophages) in a 100 mm dish with 10 mL starved media for 12 hours, or in a 6 well plate with 3 mL starved medium per well.
Trypsinize the macrophages by treating with 0.25% Trypsin-EDTA for 20–30 minutes at 37°C.
Terminate trypsinization with an equal volume of complete medium.
Harvest the treated macrophages in a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Count and add 2 × 10^4 macrophages into the FACS tube.
Add an equal number of GFP-labeled cancer cells to the FACS tube in a total volume of 200 μL.
Incubate the co-culture tubes at 37°C for 2 h.
Add 1 μL PE Cy7-conjugated anti-mouse F4/80 antibody into the FACS tube.
Incubate the mixture at 4°C for 30 min in darkness.
Wash the cells three times with FACS buffer.
Assess the phagocytosis efficiency by flow cytometry (BD FACS).
Acquire at least 1 × 10^4 cells per tube.
Calculate the phagocytic index as the number of F4/80+GFP+ cells divided by the total number of F4/80+ cells.
Place a suspension containing 2 × 10^6 single macrophages in a conical bottom polypropylene tube.
Wash the cells once using serum-free DMEM medium.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 5 min into a loose pellet.
Aspirate the supernatant carefully, leaving no more than 25 μL of supernatant.
Add 100 μl of Diluent C to the cell pellet and resuspend with gentle pipetting.
Prepare a 2×Dye Solution (4 μm) in Diluent C by adding 0.4 μl of PKH26 ethanolic dye solution to 1 ml of Diluent C and mix well.
Add 100 μL of 2×Cell Suspension to 100 μL of 2×Dye Solution.
Mix the sample by pipetting immediately.
Incubate the cell/dye suspension for 3 min with periodic mixing in darkness.
Stop the staining by adding 200 μL FBS and incubating for 1 min.
Centrifuge the cells at 400 × g for 10 min at 20°C–25°C.
Carefully remove the supernatant without removing cells.
Resuspend cell pellet in 10 mL complete DMEM medium.
Transfer the suspension to a fresh sterile conical polypropylene tube and centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min at 20°C–25°C.
Wash the cell pellet twice with 10 mL of complete DMEM medium.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 10 mL of complete medium.
Count and seed 2 × 10^4 macrophages in each well of a 24-well tissue culture plate overnight.
Incubate macrophages in starved medium for 12 h.
Add 2 × 10^4 CFSE-labelled cancer cells and incubate at 37°C for 2 h.
Wash the non-phagocytic cancer cells with PBS more than three times.
Purchase 4–6 weeks aged Balb/c nude mice from qualified companies and maintain in SPF rated conditions for one week.
Count CFSE labeled A549 lung cancer cells and adjust the cell density to 5 × 10^6/100 μL with DMEM.
Inoculate 5 × 10^6 CFSE labeled A549 cells subcutaneously in the right flank of Balb/c nude mice.
Sterilize the needle entry site with a 75% alcohol cotton ball before inoculation.
Give the mice intraperitoneal injection of monoclonal LSB2.20 or IgG every 2 days for a total of 4 injections (IgG 50 μg per injection; LSB2.20 at a dose of 25 μg, 50 μg, or 100 μg per injection).
Sacrifice the mice by CO2 inhalation 21 days later.
Mince the tumor tissue in a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 5 mL digestion buffer to the minced tumor tissue.
Digest at 37°C, shaken at 120 × rpm for 1.5 hours.
Prepare a single-cell suspension from the digested material.
Filter the cell suspension through a 70 μm cell strainer.
Wash the cells three times with DMEM.
Resuspend the cells in cold FACS buffer to adjust the density to 1 × 10^6/100 μL.
Add 1 μL APC labeled rat anti-mouse CD11b antibody per 100 μL cell suspension.
Add 1 μL PE-Cy7-labeled rat anti-mouse F4/80 antibody per 100 μL cell suspension.
Incubate the mixture at 4°C for 30 minutes in darkness.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 × g for 5 minutes.
Resuspend the cells in cold FACS buffer.
Adjust the tumor sample concentration prepared in step 42 to ensure target cells pass through the sample chamber at a rate of 100–300 cells/s, preferably around 200 cells/s.
Sort intra-tumoral macrophages based on double-positive cells labeled with APC and PE-Cy7, collecting at least 1 × 10^5 cells from each mouse.
Centrifuge the sorted macrophages at 300 × g for 5 min.
Discard the culture supernatant after centrifugation.
Extract total DNA from sorted macrophages using TIANamp Genomic DNA Kit.
Extract total DNA from M-CSF induced macrophages and A549 tumor cells using TIANamp Genomic DNA Kit.
Add 100 ng, 10 ng, 1 ng, 0.1 ng, and 0.01 ng DNA from A549 cells to mouse macrophage DNA to form a total of 200 ng DNA mixture for each sample.
Perform qRT-PCR using the prepared DNA mixtures.
Obtain the standard curve using the lg (DNA amount) value and Ct values of DNA mixtures from qRT-PCR.
Calculate the ratio of human to mouse DNA in sorted macrophages according to the standard curve.
